overview.description: The MicroSectors Travel 3x Leveraged ETN (FLYU) is an exchange-traded product that is based on the MerQube MicroSectors U.S. Travel index. The fund tracks 3x the daily price movements of a liquidity-weighted index of US-listed travel-related companies. FLYU was launched on Jun 24, 2022 and is issued by REX Microsectors.
